subject.title: [Bug]: Subagent completion silently lost — no retry, no notification, no auto-restart on timeout

question: Should this umbrella issue be resolved by adopting the open retry/error PR, by promoting the durable completion spool and closed delivery-outcome design, or by splitting the remaining auto-restart and verification requests into narrower issues?
rationale: Current code has partial hardening, but the remaining behavior crosses delivery durability, duplicate prevention, task ledger truth, and user-visible timeout policy, which automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Promote durable delivery contract
options.body: Make this issue track a proof-positive durable completion delivery model and use narrower issues/PRs only as implementation slices.

options.title: Adopt the retry/error PR
options.body: Refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90561 if maintainers want a narrower improvement before the durable design, accepting that it will not close every reported mode.

options.title: Split the umbrella
options.body: Close or narrow this only after moving timeout auto-restart and file/result verification into explicit follow-up issues with separate acceptance criteria.

recommendation.title: Promote durable delivery contract
recommendation.body: Make this issue track a proof-positive durable completion delivery model and use narrower issues/PRs only as implementation slices.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the clearest owner signal from the related durable-delivery discussion and partial-fix guidance.
